name: Seeking the Kor Gem
label: Quest
description: Seeking the Kor Gem: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A Forsaken adventurer... Here in Ashenvale? Amusing.

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the adventurers of the Alliance. Why should a fallen adventurer like you be any different?
If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, the magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.
I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you to seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... Academic pursuits.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
